tools.name: tiltify_get_current_user
tools.description: Return the Tiltify user that the access token belongs to (id, slug, username, public description, social links, total amount raised). Start here to get the user_id for tiltify_list_user_campaigns. Tiltify API: GET /api/public/current-user.

tools.name: tiltify_list_user_campaigns
tools.description: List the campaigns of a Tiltify user: amount raised, goal, status, donate URL and cause. Filter by status (published or retired). Tiltify API: GET /api/public/users/{user_id}/campaigns.

tools.name: tiltify_list_campaign_donations
tools.description: List donations to a campaign: amount, completed time, the public donor name and the donor's comment. Supporter contact data is not returned. Tiltify API: GET /api/public/campaigns/{campaign_id}/donations.

tools.name: tiltify_list_campaign_donor_leaderboard
tools.description: List the top donors of a campaign for a time window: name, amount and url, in leaderboard order. Tiltify API: GET /api/public/campaigns/{campaign_id}/donor_leaderboard.

tools.name: tiltify_list_campaign_fundraiser_leaderboard
tools.description: List the top fundraisers (users or teams that raise money) of a campaign for a time window: name, amount and url, in leaderboard order. Tiltify API: GET /api/public/campaigns/{campaign_id}/user_leaderboard.
